newsitem.title: USA: D&N Capital sets sale of pfd shares.
newsitem.headline: D&N Capital sets sale of pfd shares.

text.p: D&N Capital Corp, a unit of D&N Financial Corp, said Thursday its registration statement to offer $27.5 million of 9 percent preferred securities has become effective.
The company said it has started the sale of 1.1 million shares of the noncumulative exchangeable preferred stock at $25 a share. Underwriters are led by Roney & Co.
D&N Capital preferred stock has been approved for listing on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol "DNFCP."
D&N Capital invests in residential and commercial mortgage loans purchased from D&N Bank, a wholly-owned subsidiary of D&N Financial.
The companies said the additional capitalization provided by the preferred stock sale will permit growth of D&N Bank's balance sheet and provide flexibility for possible acquisitions.
